title: Mexican Pork Dumplings
description: A unique twist on traditional dumplings, filled with tender pork and spices, served with a side of salsa and cilantro.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine ground pork, five-spice powder, cumin, salt, and pepper. Mix well until just combined.
Add sriracha sauce and mix until the pork is well coated.
Place a tablespoon of the pork mixture onto the center of a dumpling wrapper.
Dip your finger in water and run it along the edges of the wrapper.
Fold the wrapper into a triangle, pressing the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Repeat with the remaining pork mixture and dumpling wrappers.
Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the dumplings to the skillet, being careful not to overcrowd.
Cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until the dumplings are golden brown.
Serve the dumplings with your favorite salsa and a sprinkle of cilantro.
